Choose one willing or unconscious creature within 5 squares, already secured to a rope you hold, whose weight you can support. Move the recipient up to 3 squares toward you along the clear rope-supported route, including upward. This rescue movement ignores Stability and does not provoke. A Grappled recipient can join once its hold has been released.

One willing or unconscious creature within 5 squares, already secured to a rope you hold, whose weight you can support.

Secure footing, a free hand and rope; one ordinary rope coil (Bulk 1), supplied on learning if needed.
Type
Skill / Movement / Utility

Move the recipient up to 3 squares toward you along the clear rope-supported route, including upward. This rescue movement ignores Stability and does not provoke. A Grappled recipient can join once its hold has been released.
